Every worker but `pdf-filer` runs with `omitClaudeMd`, so it never
loads this contract; `pdf-filer` still loads it, through the import
`CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Never.** NEVER write to the session memory store; anything durable belongs
in this contract or a skill.

**ALWAYS invoke the `clean-prose` skill BEFORE writing or editing instruction
text** — this contract, a skill, worker instructions, a reference file a skill
loads — including a one-sentence change.
